# Playbook: edit-activities
Use when: edit fields, cycle, milestone or labels of activities

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| changes | the user: one line per activity, "<issueId>: <field> → <new value>"; fields title, description, priority, status, cycleId, milestoneId, add label <name>, remove label <name> | STOP. Say: "Which activities, and what should change?" |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. SAVE: plan = one row per activity of <input:changes>: its issueId and the fields to set
   IF a row sets status "done" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-deliver-activity`. Say: "Closing an activity needs its closure check (criteria and evidence)."
   IF a row sets status "canceled" → switch to playbook cancel-or-delete.
   IF a row sets an owner, an estimate or a due date → switch to playbook owners-dates.
   IF a row sets a status that is neither "backlog", "todo" nor "in-progress" → STOP. Say: "Status must be backlog, todo or in-progress."
   IF a row clears a field (no new value) → STOP. Say: "Clearing a field is not done here; use the LPM web UI."
   IF <saved:plan> has more than 25 rows → STOP. Say: "I change at most 25 activities per run. Send the first 25."
   SAVE: labelIds = empty; before = empty; oldLabels = empty; after = empty
   IF no row adds or removes a label → go to step 3.
2. CALL `list_labels` {} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Reading labels needs an LPM API key (<error text>). Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: labelIds = for each label name in <input:changes>: the id of the item whose name equals it, ignoring case
   IF a name matches no item or 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Label <name> is missing or ambiguous: <each match as "<name> (<id>)">. Create it with playbook labels, or give its id."
3. FOR EACH row IN <saved:plan> (none → go to step 4):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<each:issueId> was not found in <input:projectId>: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
   IF result.status is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-deliver-activity`. Say: "<each:issueId> is <result.status>; reopening it is not planning."
   SAVE: before = <saved:before> plus "<each:issueId>: <each planned field> <its value in result, or none>"; oldLabels = <saved:oldLabels> plus "<each:issueId>: result.labelIds"
4. SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "edit-<input:projectId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"; firstId = the issueId of the first row
   SAVE: issueId, title, description, priority, status, cycleId, milestoneId, newLabels = per row of <saved:plan>: its issueId and new values; newLabels = its ids from <saved:oldLabels>, minus removed ids, plus added ids from <saved:labelIds> (labelIds replaces the whole list)
5. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":false,"operations":[{"tool":"update_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","title":"<saved:title>","description":"<saved:description>","priority":"<saved:priority>","status":"<saved:status>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>","labelIds":["<saved:newLabels>"]}}]} [A] (one operations item per row; keep in each item only the fields that row changes; labelIds = the row's full id list)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: I re-read every activity before writing."
   SAVE: failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": the issueId of its operation and its error message
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:firstId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or (<saved:firstId> is not in <saved:failed> and a planned field differs from result) → STOP. Say: "<saved:firstId> does not show the change: <error text or its values>."
6. FOR EACH row IN <saved:plan> (none → go to step 7):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error and <each:issueId> is not in <saved:failed> → STOP. Say: "<each:issueId> could not be read back: <error text>."
   IF <each:issueId> is not in <saved:failed> and a planned field differs from result → STOP. Say: "<each:issueId> does not show the change."
   SAVE: after = <saved:after> plus "<each:issueId>: <each planned field> <its value in result>"; lastStatus = result.status
7. SAVE: pending = one "<issueId> — <error>" line per entry of <saved:failed>

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>
Done: <each line of <saved:before> with its line of <saved:after>, as "old → new" | nothing changed>; status <saved:lastStatus>
Evidence: batch <saved:key>: planned <rows of <saved:plan>>, failed <entries of <saved:failed>>; read back with get_issue | none
Pending: <none | <saved:pending>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | resend only the failed ids (I build a new key) | none>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from your last get_issue. Pending is never "none" while <saved:failed> has an entry. Never claim a change that a get_issue above did not read.
